up: Retrieve all compounds that have been tested in the assay identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1741325 and for which the reported activity values are exact (i.e., standard_relation = '='). For each such compound, provide the compound's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (if available), the canonical SMILES representation of its chemical structure, and the activity details including standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Exclude any rows where the activity value is not exact (i.e., only include those with standard_relation = '='). Do not apply any additional filters.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741325' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
